01 / Understanding

AI SEO / Strategy

Which useful answers could your content provide?

Large language models process information in context. For websites, key statements need to be precise, distinct and connected to the right topics. Instead of extending copy just to include keywords, we focus on clearly answered questions, defined terms and specific descriptions of the service offered.

A strong passage should make sense on its own.
02 / Establishing context

Precision matters more than volume.

Questions are answered directly and clearly, terms are defined and claims are linked to suitable sources.

  1. 01Precise passages
  2. 02Consistent subject context
  3. 03Clear source and topic structure
03 / Ensuring quality

Review passages.
Strengthen context.

We make statements complete enough to remain understandable outside their original paragraph.

  1. 01

    Review statements

    Find unclear terms, unsupported promises and redundant passages.

  2. 02

    Improve context

    Make topical relationships and self-contained answer sections clear.

  3. 03

    Check accessibility

    Also check presentation, structured data and technical availability.
